summary: Kutt is a self-hosted URL shortener that lets you map shortened links to your own custom domains. It provides a centralised way to generate and manage concise links for your web properties. The project is distributed under an open-source MIT licence and is backed by a sizeable community of users.
goodFor: This is a good fit if you need to run your own branding for short links rather than relying on a third-party SaaS provider.
watchOut: Maintenance activity is moderate, meaning you should be prepared to handle potential security updates or community patches yourself.
deployNotes: As a Node.js application packaged with Docker, you will typically need to run it behind a reverse proxy for TLS termination and connect it to a persistent database instance.
